title: Corporate Investor Data Analysis
description: Performed an exploratory data analysis on Metropolitan Area Planning Council(MAPC) dataset which contained census information and corporate ownership rate for each neighborhood in the Boston area.

title: Interactive MapBox Visualization of BlueBike Stations
description: I utilized mapbox to visualize the total traffic of blue bike stations. And allow the uers to be able to filter based on time of day.

title: RL Computational Tool
description: I made a website that hosts a self-driving game. I made this computational tool as a part of a research opportunity program to enable middle school and high school students learn about reinforcement learning concepts.

title: Data Activism
description: I curated a curriculum that integrated social justice and data science to encourage minoritized high school students to pursue a career in STEM.

title: LLM-Powered Review Platform
description: At the MIT Media Lab Personal Robots Group, I shipped an end-to-end review platform that ingests thousands of video, code, and text submissions, transcribes audio with Whisper, and analyzes them with GPT-5.4 and Claude Opus. Low-confidence cases are escalated, automating about 75% of a manual review workflow. I benchmarked the system against 95 human-scored cases (Wilcoxon, ICC, and regression), fixed systematic underscoring of video, and published the evaluation in the AHFE International proceedings. It runs on AWS with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker, and HTTPS/TLS, with FERPA-compliant data governance.

title: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Mean Reversion Model
description: At Nasdaq, I built an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck mean-reversion model with a 15-day lookback that predicts daily closes for 10 Nasdaq-listed companies. In a walk-forward test with no look-ahead bias, it reduced RMSE by 6% versus a rolling-mean baseline.

title: Nasdaq Listing Transition Analysis
description: Modeled NYSE-listed company performance after a Nasdaq transition (R² = 0.79), quantifying statistically significant liquidity gains that supported Nasdaq’s pitch for multi-billion-dollar listings from rival exchanges.

title: SettleGuard
description: Built SettleGuard, a proof of concept to automate settlement oversight at Nasdaq. I engineered features from raw Parquet banking data and tuned a classifier to 70% recall, prioritizing failures on high-value transactions.

title: P&G Media Reach Models
description: At Procter & Gamble, I modeled drivers of media reach for Pampers, Always, Downy, and Oral-B using reach curves, regression, moving averages, and polynomial trend fitting on Meta and The Trade Desk data, quantifying the effects of frequency, cost, impressions, and targeting accuracy.

title: P&G Organic Search Rank Models
description: Modeled how sales, eContent, bid amounts, velocity, and search terms drive organic rank and share of search for P&G brands. Term placement had a larger effect than keyword inclusion.
